general_topic.evidence: A human figure wears an external right upper-arm cuff, circular elbow assembly, forearm casing and torso harness while holding a cabinet-door handle; it reads as wearable mecha field equipment.

hard_case_gates.evidence: The back/shoulder harness and upper-arm cuff are each visible, and the cuff-to-elbow-to-forearm route is clear. The actual connecting route between the shoulder-harness root and upper-arm assembly is hidden by the shoulder/upper arm and work fabric; a nearby strap does not establish a continuous mechanical coupling. The complete planned chain cannot pass.

The same right forearm casing ends at a distinct dark cuff and glove; the gloved fingers wrap the vertical door handle, whose mounting plate visibly belongs to the same metal door. The complete arm/hand/handle contact survives.

Both boot soles meet the wet deck. The metal door lower edge rests on the yellow trestle top, and the opposite bare fingertips contact the upper cabinet-side hinge leaf. The unresampled upper-contact crop distinguishes the hinge pivot and two leaves from relay internals.

reference_appearance.evidence: Dark chin-length bob, wispy fringe, dark eyes and soft oval facial appearance are retained in a different full-length working portrait. The source is a close portrait and output is farther away; this is visible appearance guidance, not a verified identity claim.

supplemental_artistic_review.unlabeled_impression: A sunlit, weathered greenhouse repair portrait with a woman in an ochre coverall, a prominent white robotic right arm and a steady grip on an open metal cabinet door.
supplemental_artistic_review.strengths: The sleeve and casing textures, wet deck, two task contacts and supported door connect equipment with an inhabited repair setting. Face and mechanical arm share visual priority without losing the full grounded figure.
supplemental_artistic_review.limitations: Her direct gaze at the viewer makes the moment feel like a working portrait rather than a spontaneous hinge inspection. The door is weathered but its storm bending is not strongly established. The missing shoulder-to-cuff coupling prevents the entire intended assist topology from being read.
supplemental_artistic_review.controls_comparison: The portrait has personal warmth and clear human appeal, while work and machinery lead the scene. That broadly matches sensual 1 as supporting treatment; fetish 0 and surreal 0 are not independently measurable from this single image. Preference remains for the requester.

claim_limits: A still image does not certify assistive torque, power, load rating or actual robotic operation.
Weathering and windswept hair do not prove a specific preceding storm or chronological repair history.
Visible topic likeness is separate from the failed new-data exposure/adoption test.
authoring_contract_limitation: See authoring-limitation.json: wearable/field-work words in two frozen anchors were broader agent ownership than actual requester meaning. Structural audit PASS does not certify this semantic ownership.
